name: IID glyph baseline
construction: Draw GLYPHs i.i.d. from the DEVELOPMENT marginal glyph-frequency distribution; draw TOKEN boundaries i.i.d. from the observed TOKEN-length distribution
target_blind: fit only on DEVELOPMENT, never on VALIDATION/HELDOUT
purpose: Distinguishes any GLYPH-level structure from pure frequency

name: Unigram token model
construction: M0 exactly: draw TOKENs i.i.d. from the DEVELOPMENT TOKEN-frequency distribution
purpose: Floor for any G1+ model claiming to beat trivial frequency fit (task85 section 20's "trivial frequency fit" contrast)

name: Simple n-gram model
construction: M1/M2 instance at a low order (e.g. order-2 GLYPH bigram), order frozen on VALIDATION only
target_blind: order selected on VALIDATION, never on HELDOUT or by Voynich target fit
purpose: Floor for any higher-order/finite-state model claiming genuine gain over short local dependence

name: Shuffled-token control
construction: Permute which observed TOKEN occupies which borrowed-skeleton slot, corpus-wide (preserves TOKEN-frequency spectrum and the skeleton exactly; destroys sequence/positional structure)
target_blind: deterministic seeded permutation of already-observed DEVELOPMENT/VALIDATION/HELDOUT data; reads no VM statistic beyond frequency and skeleton length
corresponds_to: transformation, not a fitted model class
purpose: Null for "does sequence/positional structure exist beyond frequency"

name: Formation-preserving shuffled control
construction: Permute TOKEN identities only among skeleton slots that share the same GLYPH-length class (preserves each TOKEN's own internal formation and the marginal length distribution per slot)
target_blind: construction reads only GLYPH-length class and skeleton length, defined before any VM sequence/positional statistic is computed
corresponds_to: transformation, not a fitted model class
purpose: Null for "does sequence/positional structure exist beyond frequency AND length-class", a stricter control than B3

name: Natural-language controls
construction: Reuse already provenance-valid natural-text corpora frozen elsewhere in this repository (Doyle/Longfellow/Astafiev, internal/evaglyph.NaturalGlyphs; task85 section 21 forbids ad hoc new controls unless VALIDATION shows these inadequate in scale, in which case the scale-normalized protocol of task85 section 21 applies before any VM comparison)
target_blind: corpora predate and are independent of this design
corresponds_to: external corpus substitution, not a Voynich model
purpose: Distinguishes VM-specific structure from ordinary natural-text structure

name: Message-free calibration: IID
construction: Generate a synthetic corpus from B0/B1 (a generator known, by construction, to carry no message), then run the full Task86+ grammar-fitting pipeline on that synthetic corpus
target_blind: generator constructed before any VM data is read for this purpose
purpose: Calibrates what a "successful grammar fit" looks like when the ground truth is no-message (task85 section 22), before ever fitting on VM

name: Message-free calibration: Markov
construction: Generate a synthetic corpus from a frozen M1/M2 instance, then run the full Task86+ pipeline on it

name: Message-free calibration: constrained formation
construction: Generate a synthetic corpus from a frozen M3/M4/M5 instance, then run the full Task86+ pipeline on it
purpose: As MFC0, at the finite-state/component-grammar level; directly calibrates "grammar detected" against a known constrained-but-message-free generator

name: Message-free calibration: shuffled-grammar-like
construction: Apply a B3/B4-style shuffle to one of MFC0-MFC2's own synthetic outputs, then run the full Task86+ pipeline on the shuffled version
purpose: As MFC0, isolating what sequence/positional structure a grammar-detection pipeline could spuriously "recover" from a shuffled, still message-free, corpus
